segments.name: Professional Staffing Services
segments.description: Provides temporary and permanent placement of specialized professionals in IT, engineering, accounting and finance, office support and healthcare to U.S. customers.
segments.evidence: Our contract and placement services are currently provided under our Professional Staffing Services operating division or segment.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the company acquired Hornet Staffing, Inc., broadening its professional contract staffing footprint within the Professional Staffing Services segment.
changes.evidence: We acquired Hornet Staffing, Inc., a Georgia corporation, ("Hornet") on January 3, 2025, broadening our footprint in the professional contract staffing market with a specialty in working with managed service providers ("MSP") and vendor management systems ("VMS") that streamline outsourced labor for large clients.
